claim: The product reads cleanly, honestly, and never half-finishes. NO MID-SENTENCE: a reply never ends on a dangling fragment (_finish_on_sentence trims to the last complete sentence). ENV INDICATOR: the dashboard tells the user where they are (prod vs local) from the host. NO DEAD CONTROLS: the removed `</>` code toggle is gone and the upload advertises what it accepts. HONEST COMPOSER: a calm plain-language prompt ('What's on your mind?'), not internal jargon. CAPABILITY-TRUTH: when Vera can't do something it says WHY (permission/enable), not a generic 'I can't'. NEVER BREAKS CHARACTER: the #1 rule holds — a reply that disowns her as software is scrubbed by the final output gate.
owner: anima/web/index.html (env indicator, composer, upload advertise, no dead controls), anima/mouth.py (_finish_on_sentence, final_output_gate #1-rule scrub), anima/route.py + host_awareness.py (capability-truth honest denials), scripts/certify_product_polish.py

killer_test.name: clean_honest_never_half_finished
killer_test.setup: scripts/certify_product_polish.py proves: _finish_on_sentence trims a dangling fragment + leaves clean replies; the dashboard shows the env from the host; the dead `</>` control is gone and the upload advertises formats; the composer is plain-language; route/host_awareness explain WHY an action can't run; final_output_gate scrubs #1-rule character breaks.
killer_test.prompt: read a reply / open the dashboard / ask for a disabled capability

known_gaps: A full collapsible single-page reorg and per-card human-speak (the Argus-style Operations treatment) is a richer UX pass; this cert proves the load-bearing polish invariants (no mid-sentence, env-aware, no dead controls, honest denials, never-breaks-character).
